parameters.name: beginTime
parameters.description: The start time of the event query.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: The end time of the event query.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number for a paged query.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query.

parameters.name: termContent
parameters.description: The filter object content. If this parameter is left empty, event records of all instances are returned. The value varies based on the filter type.

parameters.name: termType
parameters.description: The filter object type. If this parameter is left empty, event records of all types are returned.
